# Be-Ambitious Harness — a planner / worker / verifier workflow for ambitious AI tasks

> Make AI agents aim higher without losing control: two bars for every task, a cheap gate check before expensive work, and an independent verifier that never sees the worker's reasoning.

## What it is: a prompt engineering framework, a Claude Code skill, a multi-agent workflow

Most AI prompts ask for a step: *fix this bug, make this screen, analyze this CSV.* The outcome you wanted — *the app stops crashing, users finish checkout, you know why churn rose* — stays implicit, so the model delivers the step and stops.

Be-Ambitious Harness is a **prompt engineering framework and multi-agent workflow** that turns any task into a prompt with:

- **Two bars** — the baseline result and a more ambitious one, with the extra work and the main uncertainty named.
- **A gate check** — a cheap, observable test that decides whether the ambitious path is worth starting, with a pass criterion fixed *before* the test runs and three outcomes: passed, failed, insufficient data.

# old-phone-tailnet · 旧手机接进私网

把一台**没有 root** 的旧安卓手机接进你自己的 Tailscale 私网：在电脑上 `ssh` 进手机，再通过 `localhost:9222` 用 CDP 访问手机上的 Chrome。

**Termux + 用户态 Tailscale + 只认公钥的 SSH + 本机无线 ADB + Chrome 调试口**

## 三种用法，挑一种

### 1. 复制提示词（最简单）
把 [prompt.md](prompt.md) 整段贴给任何一个 AI 助手（Claude、ChatGPT、DeepSeek、豆包都行），它会一步一步带你配完。

### 2. 装成 Claude Code skill
```bash
git clone https://github.com/ythx-101/old-phone-tailnet
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
cp -r old-phone-tailnet/skills/old-phone-tailnet ~/.claude/skills/
```
然后在 Claude Code 里说「帮我把旧手机接进私网」。SSH 打通之前它带你一步步在 Termux 里操作；打通以后，它可以直接替你跑自检。

### 3. 自己照着脚本做
| 脚本 | 在哪跑 | 做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `install-tailscale.sh` | 手机 Termux | 下载 Tailscale 官方最新静态版到 `~/bin` |
| `harden-ssh.sh` | 手机 Termux | 关闭密码登录，只认公钥（会先检查公钥已经放好） |
| `start.sh` | 手机 Termux | 一键拉起唤醒锁、sshd、Tailscale，并启动 adb 掉线重连和 9222 转发 |
| `check.sh` | 手机 Termux | 只读自检：SSH、Tailscale、adb、9222、公网隧道 |
| `pc-connect.sh` | 电脑 | 经 Tailscale 把手机的 9222 转发到电脑本机 |

完整步骤见 [SKILL.md](skills/old-phone-tailnet/SKILL.md)。

## 需要准备
- Android 11 或更新的手机（无线调试从 11 开始才有），连着 Wi-Fi
- 从 F-Droid 装的 Termux
- 一台装好 Tailscale 的电脑

## 为什么这么配
- **用户态 Tailscale**：不占安卓唯一的 VPN 位，能和代理工具同时开。
- **adb 连回自己**：不用 root，也能在手机上用 adb，转发 Chrome 的调试套接字。
- **只走私网**：SSH 和 9222 都不暴露到公网，只有你 Tailscale 里的设备能连。

## 安全
能 SSH 进这台手机的人，也能通过 adb 和 Chrome 调试口操作它，包括手机上已经登录的网页。所以：
- 私钥保管好，SSH 只认公钥；
- 不开公网隧道，只走 Tailscale；
- **注意**：用户态 Tailscale 会把发到手机 100.x 的连接转给手机本机，tailnet 里的设备不用 SSH 就能直接连 `100.x:9222`。tailnet 里有别人的设备时，用 Tailscale ACL 只放行 8022（示例见 [SKILL.md](skills/old-phone-tailnet/SKILL.md) 第 8 步）；
- `adb tcpip 5555` 会在 Wi-Fi 上监听 5555，只关「无线调试」不一定关得掉。在公共 Wi-Fi 下请关掉「USB 调试」或重启手机；
- 最好用一台专门的旧手机，不装银行和支付类 App。

## 已知限制
- 重启手机后「无线调试」会自动关掉，需要手动打开一次，再运行 `bash start.sh :<端口>`。
- userspace 模式下，手机上的其他 App 不能主动访问私网里的其他机器，但从外面连进手机不受影响。
- Android 12 起系统会杀 Termux 的后台子进程，要按 SKILL.md 第 4 步解除限制。
- 不同品牌的系统省电策略不一样。如果 Termux 老被杀，在系统设置里把它加进省电白名单，并在多任务界面锁住它。

# Motion For Anything You Draw

For designers and engineers who want to bring their apps and drawings to life.

Making a drawing move is easy. Making it feel alive is hard: it has to breathe, look around, blink, shift its weight and act, without ever freezing or jumping. This skill helps your agent get there.

It started as the method I used to bring the illustrations in my app to life, and grew into a way to animate anything drawn: characters and creatures, plants, cloth, fire, smoke, water, weather, lights, machines, icons, logos, charts and whole scenes.

The animation above is drawn and animated entirely in code, with the templates in this repo.

## Install

```bash
npx skills@latest add rossark0/rossark-motion-skill
```

## Why use it?

Agents don't animate like animators.

Ask an agent to bring a character to life and it will often swap one drawing for another, so the face teleports from one expression to the next. It moves through each pose with its own eased tween, so the body stops dead at every pose. Everything moves in sync, like a machine. Blinks are so short they flicker, everything bounces, and a thin line shows across the face where two shapes meet.

All these small things add up, and the result looks like a slideshow instead of something alive.

This skill lists those mistakes and how to fix them: one clock for the whole scene, parts that turn around their real pivots, trailing parts that follow a beat later, idle life that never stops, smooth paths through key poses, small amplitudes and strong curves. When you have a reference video, it measures the motion frame by frame before building, because what makes a reference feel alive is often too small to see.

For motion in an interface, it follows [Emil Kowalski's](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills) rules and Benji Taylor's [Family values](https://benji.org/family-values).

# Ian XHS Carousel

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

> 把文章、案例或笔记，排成一组 3:4 的小红书图文。
>
> 1080×1440 竖版 | 20 个母版 | 浅色 / 深色 | Claude Code Skill

---

## 这是什么

Ian XHS Carousel 是一个 AI Skill，把你的内容做成一组小红书轮播图，风格是简洁的产品界面风。

你把内容交给它，它先出一张分镜表给你确认，确认后再排版、出图。

**最好用 Claude 跑。**

---

## 适合谁用

- 写文章、做案例拆解，想顺手发一份小红书图文的人
- 做 AI、产品、设计、效率工具内容，图里常有截图、步骤、对比、数据、代码的人
- 想让每期图文风格统一、看着干净的人

想要手绘、插画、大色块海报这类风格的话，这个不太合适。

---

## 它会产出什么

- **分镜表**：每页讲什么、用哪个母版、标题怎么写，先给你确认
- **每页一张 PNG**：1080×1440，可以直接发
- **总览图**：所有页排在一起，一眼看整组节奏
- **HTML 源文件**：想自己改字、换图，改完重新渲染就行

浅色、深色两版都能出，版式一样。

小红书帖子的标题、正文和话题标签需要你另外写。

---

## 20 个母版

深色版

| 分组 | 母版 |
|---|---|
| 封面 | T01 对话框、T02 窗口、T03 通知 |
| 讲做法 | T04 步骤、T05 清单、T06 时间线 |
| 对比 | T07 对错、T08 前后双栏 |
| 展示 | T09 宫格、T10 截图标注、T11 手机截图、T12 应用列表 |
| 数字 | T13 数据指标、T14 参数设置 |
| 文字 | T15 观点大字、T16 聊天、T17 提示词、T18 代码 |
| 结尾 | T19 对照、T20 完成 |

20 个都不合适的时候，AI 会用同一套样式拼一个新排法。

---

## 安装

**1. 下载并复制到 Claude Code**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/helloianneo/ian-xhs-carousel.git
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
cp -R ./ian-xhs-carousel/ian-xhs-carousel ~/.claude/skills/
```

**2. 装渲染要用的工具**（第一次用时装一次）

```bash
pip install playwright pillow
playwright install chromium
```

渲染时会联网加载英文和代码字体，记得保持网络畅通。

---

## 素材要好看

一组图好不好看，很大程度看你给的素材。上传前花几分钟挑一挑：

- **截图**：用高清的，裁掉浏览器工具栏、桌面和别的窗口；做深色版就截深色模式的
- **Logo 和图标**：用官方的 SVG，别截一个小图再放大
- **照片和效果图**：一堆里挑最好看的那张
- **没有好图**：先空着，它会在分镜表里列出来问你要，别拿糊的凑

---

## 怎么用

在 Claude Code 里输入：

```text
/ian-xhs-carousel 把下面这篇文章做成一组小红书图文。

<粘贴文章>
```

不输命令也行，直接说"把这篇做成小红书"，它一般会自己用上。

**只要分镜表**

```text
/ian-xhs-carousel 先别排版，帮我看看下面这篇能做成几页，出分镜表就行。

<粘贴文章>
```

**出深色版**

```text
/ian-xhs-carousel 把这篇做成小红书图文，用深色主题。截图在 ./shots 里。

<粘贴文章>
```

**改某一页**

```text
第 3 页换成 T08 前后双栏，左边放旧版截图，右边放新版。
```

更多示例见 [examples/prompts.md](examples/prompts.md)。

---

## 工作流程

1. **读内容**：想清楚这组图要让人带走什么
2. **出分镜表**：一页讲一件事，一般 5 页左右，**停下来等你确认**
3. **准备配图**：用你给的素材，缺的会列出来问你
4. **排版**：从 20 个母版里挑合适的
5. **渲染和自查**：检查文字溢出、字号、配色，有问题自己改掉
6. **交付**：给你每页图和总览图

---

## 小贴士

- 分镜表那一步多花点时间，页数和每页讲什么定下来，后面…

Style library, design system, composable components, and more.

  Tamagui is a bunch of libraries for building UIs that share code across React and React Native.

- `@tamagui/core` - Universal style library for React.
- `@tamagui/static` - Optimizing compiler that works with `core` and `tamagui`.
- `tamagui` - UI kit that adapts to every platform.

**See [tamagui.dev](https://tamagui.dev) for documentation.**

Tamagui lets you share more code between web and native apps without sacrificing the two things that typically suffer when you do: performance and code quality.

It does this with an optimizing compiler that outputs platform-specific optimizations - it turns styled components, even with complex logic or cross-module imports, into a simple `div` alongside atomic CSS on the web, or a View with its style objects hoisted on native.

The entirety of Tamagui works at compile time and runtime, and can be set up gradually, with initial usage as simple as importing it and using the base views and styled function.

We recommend checking out the starters with `npm create tamagui@latest`, they range from a simple learning example to a production-ready monorepo.

The compiler optimizes most and ultimately flattens a majority of styled components. In the [~500px² responsive browser section](https://tamagui.dev) of the Tamagui website, 49 of the 55 or so [inline styled components](https://github.com/tamagui/tamagui/blob/main/code/tamagui.dev/components/HeroResponsive.tsx) are flattened to a `div`. # Brotli Checker

Brotli Checker finds copies of the Brotli decoder that may need an update for
[CVE-2026-111497](skills/brotli-checker/references/advisory.md). Install it as a
Claude Code or Codex skill, then ask it to check your project.

The skill scans source, dependencies, app packages, and unpacked container
filesystems. It checks source fingerprints and supported ELF binary code,
investigates which copies the app uses, and explains what to update or review.
Each copy keeps its own result.

For source review, [Trailmark](https://github.com/trailofbits/trailmark) maps calls
to the decoder and fetch APIs, helping the assistant find callers to inspect.
The scanner finds suspect parts; Trailmark helps show how the code connects.
The assistant checks whether those connections apply to the running app.

## Install and use

Ask Claude Code or Codex:

```text
Install the brotli-checker skill from https://github.com/trailofbits/brotli-checker/tree/main/skills/brotli-checker
```

For manual installation, copy the entire `skills/brotli-checker` folder into
`~/.claude/skills/` ([Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills)) or
`~/.codex/skills/` (Codex). Start a new session, open the project to check, and ask:

```text
Use brotli-checker to check this project and tell me whether I need to update anything.
```

You can also name a folder or app package. With only a website address, the skill
explains what is missing and prepares a request for your hosting provider.
HTTP headers cannot establish the decoder's patch status.

Requires **Python 3.12–3.15** and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) for Trailmark
source discovery. The standalone scanner uses only the standard library.

## Run the scanner directly

To collect local evidence without an agent:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/trailofbits/brotli-checker.git
cd brotli-checker
python3 skills/brotli-checker/scripts/brotli_inventory.py /path/to/application
```

eRPC is a fault-tolerant RPC proxy with **re-org-aware permanent caching**, serving both EVM chains and SVM (Solana) clusters. It sits in front of all your upstreams — managed providers and your own nodes — behind a single endpoint, and handles failover, retries, caching, and multi-chain routing automatically. Built for read-heavy workloads such as data indexing and high-load frontends.

---

### Quick Start

With the below setup, you get immediate access to 2,000+ EVM chains and 4,000+ public free EVM RPC endpoints. SVM (Solana) networks are configured explicitly — see below.

#### Run an eRPC instance:

Using `npx`:

```bash
npx start-erpc
```

Or, using `Docker`:

```bash
docker run -p 4000:4000 ghcr.io/erpc/erpc
```

Or, using `Railway`:

#### Send a request to your eRPC instance:

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:4000/main/evm/42161' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
    "method": "eth_getBlockByNumber",
    "params": ["latest", false],
    "id": 9199,
    "jsonrpc": "2.0"
}'
```

#### Send a request against a Solana cluster (SVM):

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:4000/main/svm/mainnet-beta' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
    "method": "getSlot",
    "params": [{"commitment":"confirmed"}],
    "id": 1,
    "jsonrpc": "2.0"
}'
```

# Sage Design Tokens

This repository contains the design tokens from the Sage Design System. These are maintained by the Sage DS team. This library is for distributing these tokens across multiple platforms.

## What are design tokens?

Design Tokens are Design System’s most basic, lowest level element. In atomic design terminology those would be the protons or electrons.

Basically those are **key-value records named and organized the same way regardless of the platform** (e.g. web, Android, iOS, Figma). They can define various properties, such as colors, paddings, margins, sizes, font sizes, font families, transitions, animations, and others. **They represent certain design decisions.**

Design tokens purpose is to:
- **Release developers from taking design decisions.** Often while developing a component, developer needs to take decision what tint of what color should be used. This decision should be taken by designer, not developer.
- **Improve handover process and communication between designers and developers.** Both, developers and designers are going to use the same token name for given property (color, background color, border, padding, margin, transition and so on). In the end, developers don't need to know what the final value will be.
- **Narrow value set to only needed values.** Design System uses narrow set of values (spacings, colors, typography properties and others). Those are only values that are needed for visual description of the component.

Corsair is a fully-featured product integration platform with a seamless DX. Build anything, from an agent working across all your integrations to a multi-tenant dashboard for your users to connect to anything.

## Why does this exist?

### More than MCP

Most agent integration tools are MCP-only. Corsair is built on a REST API, so the same integration layer works for agents, backend services, and the dashboards your customers use.

### One syntax for every integration

The more third-party APIs your agent touches, the more glue code you write. Corsair gives every integration the same syntax, and we maintain the adapters behind it. Connect once instead of rewriting plumbing for each new tool.

### Open source, your data

Closed integration platforms keep your users' tokens and data on infrastructure you can't inspect or leave. Corsair is open source. Self-host it, or use Hub if you want us to handle OAuth refresh and webhooks. Your data remains yours either way.

## About

**Open source factory for one-shot engineering.**

SuperPlane turns high-confidence backlog issues into verified, review-ready
pull requests so engineers can focus on work that needs judgment.

SuperPlane lets AI agents fully automate routine development work. It
coordinates coding agents, source control, CI, review, approvals and feedback
in one visible system so engineers do not have to project-manage every step.

The factory continuously evaluates which backlog issues agents can handle with
high confidence. It applies the same workflow-level guardrails to every run,
checks the result and sends failures back to the agent with actionable context.
Ambiguous work and decisions that need human judgment stay with your team.

SuperPlane is built on an Apache 2.0 open source engine. Choose your models,
run in the cloud or on-prem and build the factory around your stack and cost
constraints.

## How the factory works

A SuperPlane Factory turns incoming work into a durable operational record.
A work order enters through the backlog, moves through one or more automation
lines and produces pull requests, notes, branches and other reviewable
artifacts.

| Resource | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Factory** | Holds work orders, automation lines and the policies for a team. |
| **Work order** | Records one delegated task from intake through its final outcome. |

| **Automation** | Runs an agent, calls a tool, waits for an event or requires approval through a Canvas-backed app. |
| **Run** | Tracks durable execution, inputs, outputs, retries and cost for one automation step. |
